title: Signal: Possible a Supabase service key literal assigned to SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY in source
scope: One line, matching a Supabase service key literal assigned to SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY.
limitations: Shape-only: a 20+ character token-shaped literal assigned to a token-named key. It cannot prove the token is valid or unrevoked.
fpNotes: Documentation snippets and example configurations that use the same variable name with placeholder bodies are the common false positives; the rule vetoes EXAMPLE text and requires 20+ characters with a digit.
